deploybot: Rollback initiated for service runtime-api in prod-eu2 — reason: canary 5xx spike detected at 09:12 UTC. Rolling back to tag v1.4.2 (commit abcdef12). Change window: 09:00-11:00 UTC. Version lock enabled.
Anisha Patel: Ack, oncall here. I'll watch the dashboards and keep canary traffic pinned.
Will Chen: Thanks. ETA for completion? Any manual steps required?
deploybot: Rollback steps: 1) stop new canaries -> done; 2) revert traffic routing -> in progress.
Sara Gomez: Confirming: pin runtime-api to v1.4.2 and disable auto-rollout? Also set autoscaler to stable policy.
deploybot: Version lock applied: runtime-api -> v1.4.2. Autoscaling policy set to `stable`. Rollback command used: `deployctl rollback runtime-api --to v1.4.2 --env prod-eu2 --no-auto`
Jamie Ortiz: Ran quick smoke on eu2: all green on v1.4.2 (latency & 5xx ok). :thumbsup:
Will Chen: Good. If error rate doesn't drop within 3m escalate to SRE channel.
deploybot: Rollback completed at 09:18 UTC. All live instances on v1.4.2 (commit abcdef12). Canary traffic stable at ~0.5% with 5xx back to baseline. Post-rollback actions: created ticket #5234 (observability + root-cause).
Anisha Patel: I'll open the RCA and schedule a follow-up with platform + runtime teams. Pinning the version in the console now.
deploybot: Pin set: runtime-api = 1.4.2. Metadata: rollback_ticket=#5234, change_window_note='rolled back during maintenance window', pinned_until='temporary - until RCA complete'. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/2167894321
Jamie Ortiz: Leaving extra eyes on logging until EOD. :eyes:
Will Chen: Thanks everyone. Once RCA is out we'll decide whether to cherry-pick fixes or roll forward. Re-open thread if any regressions appear.
